ko: 새 힘 얻으리 주를 바랄 때
주를 바랄 때 우리 주를 바랄 때
en: Strength’ll rise as we wait upon the Lord we’ll wait upon the Lord we will wait upon the Lord

ko: 당신은 영원하신 주 내 영원하신 주
en: Our God You reign forever Our hope our strong deliverer You are the everlasting God You do not faint You won’t grow weary

ko: 약한 자 방패 되시며 위로자 되신 주
en: You’re the defender of the weak You comfort those in need You lift us up on wings like eagles
